name: BigSEO Pages
author: kailasnathr

sections.description:
BigSEO Pages is a WordPress plugin built for marketers, agencies, and SEO professionals who need to generate large volumes of location-based, service-based, or data-driven pages at scale — without touching code.

Generate thousands of SEO-optimised pages from CSV. Unlimited rows, built-in schema, meta, sitemap, cron & WP-CLI — 100% Free.

Core Features

  • Unlimited rows — no artificial page limits
  • Unlimited projects — run multiple campaigns simultaneously
  • 2 data sources — CSV via URL, CSV Upload (server path)
  • Smart update engine — existing pages are updated, not duplicated
  • Orphan detection — auto-delete pages removed from the data source
  • Any post type — Pages, Posts, or any custom post type

Template Engine

  • {{placeholder}} — column value substitution (HTML-escaped)
  • {{raw:placeholder}} — unescaped HTML column output
  • {Option A|Option B|Option C} — spintax for content variation
  • [if:column=value]…[/if] — conditional blocks
  • Supports =, !=, >, <, >=, <= operators

SEO Features

  • Custom title tag and meta description per page
  • Robots meta control (index/noindex per project)
  • Canonical URL auto-injected
  • 6 Schema types — Article, LocalBusiness, Product, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, JobPosting
  • JSON-LD schema output in head
  • Custom XML sitemap at /pseo-sitemap.xml
  • Compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math

Automation

  • Auto-sync — hourly, daily, weekly via WP Cron
  • WP-CLI — generate/delete/list from terminal
  • Scheduled cron runs independently of user action

Developer Features

  • PSR-4 style class autoloader
  • pseo_schema filter hook for custom schema
  • Clean database with 3 custom tables
  • Nonce-protected AJAX endpoints
  • Full manage_options capability checks
  • All inputs sanitized, all outputs escaped
  • WordPress Plugin Check (PCP) compliant — 0 errors
sections.installation:
Method 1 — Upload ZIP (Recommended)

  1. Zip the knr-pseo-generator/ folder
  2. Go to WP Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select zip > Install Now > Activate
  4. Go to Settings > Permalinks > Save Changes (required)

Method 2 — Manual FTP

  1. Upload knr-pseo-generator/ to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins > Activate
  3. Go to Settings > Permalinks > Save Changes

Method 3 — WP-CLI

wp plugin install /path/to/knr-pseo-generator.zip --activate
wp rewrite flush
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor or Divi?

Yes. Set your Elementor or Divi built page as the Content Template — placeholders inside it will be replaced.

Will it conflict with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. BigSEO Pages meta tags fire at priority 1. Both can coexist.

Can I edit generated pages manually?

Yes, but manual edits are overwritten on the next Generate run. Use the CSV and template instead.

Is there a page limit?

No plugin limit. For 10,000+ pages use WP-CLI to avoid PHP timeouts.

Can I use custom post types?

Yes. Any public post type appears in the Generate as Post Type dropdown.

Why were JSON URL and REST API sources removed?

The plugin is now focused on CSV-based workflows only. This keeps the UI clean and reduces complexity for most users.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Renamed plugin to BigSEO Pages
  • Simplified data sources — CSV only (URL + server path)
  • Fixed critical white screen bug on project save
  • Fixed source_config double-encoding via json_decode()
  • Fixed orphaned delete_orphans line in class-pseo-ajax.php
  • Fixed AJAX JS not loading on admin pages
  • Fixed JS object name mismatch in wp_localize_script
  • Fixed all text domain mismatches throughout admin class
  • UI fix — action buttons now display in 2×2 grid layout
  • Security — added wp_unslash() to all $_POST reads
  • Security — all outputs escaped with esc_attr / esc_html / esc_url
  • WordPress Plugin Check (PCP) compliant — 0 errors

2.0.1

  • Fixed text domain mismatch
  • Fixed README missing WordPress.org required headers
  • Removed deprecated load_plugin_textdomain() call
  • Fixed unescaped output variables in view files
  • Added nonce verification to AJAX handlers
  • Prefixed global variables in view templates

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Template engine with placeholders, spintax, conditionals
  • 6 JSON-LD schema types
  • Custom XML sitemap
  • WP-CLI integration
  • Hourly WP Cron auto-sync
  • Full AJAX admin UI
  • Nonce-protected AJAX security
